title: Design: the New Category page, its error and its created message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a client connected to QuickBooks, so the QuickBooks Products And Services field shows.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click New Category.
  3. Click Create Category.
  4. Type a name no other category uses.
  5. Click Create Category.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows a blue New Category button.

Step 2:

  • The breadcrumb reads Categories › New Category, starting at Categories with no Settings crumb.
  • A large empty name field with the placeholder "Category name" holds the cursor; Cancel and a blue Create Category sit at the top right.
  • Under it sit the Pricing Matrix picker (reading "General Matrix (no matrix of its own)"), an info icon, the QuickBooks Products And Services picker and Tax Exempt.
  • Below, "General Matrix" with a Default badge labels the read-only grid, as in picture 8.6.

Step 3:

  • Red text under the field reads "Name is a required field".
  • The field is outlined in red, as in picture 8.7.

Step 4:

  • The name shows in the large field.

Step 5:

  • A white message at the bottom right reads the new name with "created" and "Priced by General Matrix for every tier."
  • The page now shows the name as its title, a three-dot button and New Matrix, as in picture 8.9.
